model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази графика илюстрира връзката между Perplexity и Sparsity Rate за два типа данни: Per-Output и Per-Layer. Хоризонталната ос показва Sparsity Rate, която варира от 10% до 80% на интервали от 10%, като всяка категория е етикетирана със съответния процент. Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като Perplexity и е с логаритмична скала от $10^1$ до $10^3$, със стойностите $10^1$, $10^2$ и $10^3$ ясно означени. Има две групи стълби, всяка от които представлява Per-Output и Per-Layer, съответно оцветени в синьо и оранжево. За всяка група, стълбите показват последователно увеличение на височината при увеличаване на Sparsity Rate от 10% до 80%, като стойностите за Per-Output и Per-Layer са много близки една до друга за всяка дадена категория на Sparsity Rate. Представителни стойности са: при 10% стълбите са близо до $10^1$; при 50% са близо до $10^2$; а при 80% са малко над $10^3$. Няма допълнително групиране, наслагване или подчертаване на стълбите освен цветовото кодиране според типа данни.
model_annotations.Chinese: This graph displays the relationship between sparsity rate and perplexity, with two categories: Per-Output and Per-Layer. The horizontal axis represents the sparsity rate, labeled with percentages ranging from 10% to 80% in increments of 10%, with no apparent specific unit. The vertical axis represents perplexity, labeled with values ranging from 10^1 to 10^3, with a logarithmic scale, and no specific unit is provided. Two sets of bars, one for Per-Output and one for Per-Layer, are depicted, with Per-Output shown in blue and Per-Layer in orange. The Per-Output bars have approximate values of 30, 40, 45, 60, 80, 150, and 800, while the Per-Layer bars have approximate values of 25, 35, 40, 60, 80, 150, and 800, with the highest values occurring at the 80% sparsity rate. The bars increase in height as the sparsity rate increases. The bars are grouped by sparsity rate, with each group consisting of one Per-Output and one Per-Layer bar. The bars are arranged in order of increasing sparsity rate, with no apparent visual emphasis.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the relationship between sparsity rate and perplexity for two types of measurements: Per-Output and Per-Layer. The horizontal axis represents the sparsity rate, labeled with percentages from 10% to 80% in increments of 10%, and has a linear scale. The vertical axis represents perplexity, labeled with values from 10^1 to 10^3 in a logarithmic scale. The chart features two sets of bars, one in blue (Per-Output) and the other in orange (Per-Layer). Each set of bars corresponds to a specific sparsity rate, with the Per-Output bars having approximate values of 32 at 10% sparsity, 60 at 30%, 90 at 50%, 140 at 60%, 260 at 70%, and 940 at 80%, and the Per-Layer bars having approximate values of 28 at 10% sparsity, 50 at 30%, 80 at 50%, 120 at 60%, 220 at 70%, and 980 at 80%. The bars are sorted in ascending order of sparsity rate, and there is no additional visual emphasis on any of the bars.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt die Beziehung zwischen dem Sparsity Rate und der Perplexity für zwei Kategorien, dargestellt durch blaue und orangefarbene Balken. Die horizontale Achse stellt den Sparsity Rate dar, mit Beschriftungen von 10 % bis 80 % in Schritten von 10 %. Die vertikale Achse stellt die Perplexity dar, mit einer logarithmischen Skala von $10^1$ bis $10^3$. Die blauen Balken stellen die Kategorie "Per-Output" dar, während die orangefarbenen Balken die Kategorie "Per-Layer" repräsentieren. Die Balken sind nicht in einer bestimmten Reihenfolge sortiert. Es gibt keine hervorgehobenen Balken. Die Perplexity-Werte für beide Kategorien nehmen mit zunehmendem Sparsity Rate zu. Die Werte für die Kategorie "Per-Output" liegen bei etwa $10^2$ für einen Sparsity Rate von 10 % und erreichen knapp $10^3$ bei einem Sparsity Rate von 80 %. Die Werte für die Kategorie "Per-Layer" liegen bei etwa $6 * 10^1$ für einen Sparsity Rate von 10 % und erreichen etwa $10^3$ bei einem Sparsity Rate von 80 %.
